description.en: One-click restart of the DSH service from Settings → General. A dsh-plugin for DeepSeek Harness; the restart row stays pinned at the bottom of the general settings page.  在设置 → 通用设置中一键重启 DSH 服务。DeepSeek Harness 的 dsh-plugin，重启行固定显示在通用设置页面最底部。
description.zh: 在设置→通用设置中一键重启 DSH 服务，重启按钮固定在页面底部，方便快捷。

description.en: Structural code intelligence for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — gives the agent codegraph and codegraph_index tools to find where a symbol is declared, what calls it, and what a change   reaches, from a tree-sitter index it builds itself. Compatible with the codegraph CLI's on-disk format.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供代码结构分析工具，快速定位符号声明、调用关系及变更影响范围。

description.en: Per-conversation x-opencode-session injection for OpenCode Go in DeepSeek Harness - fixes 400 MissingSessionID without breaking other providers
description.zh: 给 OpenCode Go 按会话注入 x-opencode-session 请求头，修好 400 MissingSessionID 报错，还不影响其他模型服务商。

description.en: ♾️ Copy and export the LaTeX in DeepSeek Harness 悬停任意 LaTeX 公式即可复制 TeX 源码或导出为独立的 SVG 文件
description.zh: 悬停任意 LaTeX 公式，就能复制 TeX 源码或导出成独立 SVG 文件

description.en: Turn-atomic message editing, retry, reroll and version-tree navigation for DeepSeek Harness conversations — the restart-safe successor to dsh-message-edit
Switch between Chat and Agent without leaving your DeepSeek Harness session.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中一键切换聊天和智能体模式，不用打断当前会话。

description.en: 不用一直在电脑前，远程操控Deepseek Harness，在飞书 / 企业微信 / Telegram 里指挥 DeepSeek Harness：远程派活 · 结果通知 · 危险操作审批
description.zh: 在飞书、企业微信或 Telegram 里远程指挥 DeepSeek Harness，派活、收通知、审批危险操作。

description.en: Automatic cross-session GoodMemory recall and writeback for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 自动记住跨会话的对话内容，随时回忆并写入，提升连续对话体验。

description.en: Bridge codex skills and config into DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: dsh-plugin-codex-bridge — DSH 插件（技能）

description.en: Anspire AI Search plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — 全网搜索 + 垂域结构化数据
description.zh: 给 AI 助手接上全网搜索，网页图片视频加天气股票汇率等实时数据一搜就有。

description.en: 基于隐藏影子 jj 仓库的会话级文件快照与回退，并内置 AI 改动文件审查：侧边栏 diff、聊天轮尾卡片、hunk 级撤销/重做、终端写盘审计（检查点窗口归属 + 轮末检查点精确归属 + 写盘归因 + 可撤销）、Code Mode 录制（融合 dsh-file-review-tab）。

Model-facing codegraph tools for DeepSeek Harness — a read-only codegraph tool with ten structural query operations plus a codegraph_index tool that builds or refreshes the index on its own timeout budget

Self-built code-graph indexer for DeepSeek Harness — parses a workspace with web-tree-sitter and writes schema version 4 to .codegraph/codegraph.db, the same on-disk format the codegraph CLI writes, so no external indexer is required
Octodeck deck capability for DeepSeek Harness: deck tools, a live preview server, and the deck canvas
DeepSeek Harness plugin: multimodal tools (image/audio/video/document understanding, transcription, image generation) via Gemini API or the local Antigravity CLI.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 装上 Gemini 的眼睛和耳朵，让它能看懂图片、听懂音频，处理多模态任务。

description.en: dsh·通知叮咚插件。agent 提问或跑完一轮时，弹浏览器系统通知并让宿主进程播放 Windows 内置提示音，人跑去别的窗口时也能被叫回来；纯插件自包含，不改 DSH 源码。
description.zh: DSH 需要你回答或跑完一轮时，弹系统通知加提示音，人不在电脑前也能被叫回来。

description.en: Hover timestamps for DSH web. Hovering a chat node row — Think, Bash, Read/Edit/Write, Search, commands, compaction markers, sub-calls — pops a compact card with that node's start time → end time and how long it took.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页聊天界面中，鼠标悬停任意节点即可快速查看其开始与结束时间，方便排查耗时与性能问题。

description.en: A skill management plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) desktop: list / enable / disable / delete / add skills, filling the gap in dsh's official skill toggle control.
description.zh: 管理 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端的技能，支持查看、启用、禁用、删除和添加，补全官方缺失的技能开关控制。

description.en: Phone-side command center (plugin + zero-knowledge relay + PWA): dispatch tasks into isolated git worktrees from your phone, approval push notifications with phone/desktop first-answer-wins (never auto-approved), and a multi-machine session board; E2E encrypted, self-hostable.
description.zh: 在手机上给 DeepSeek Harness 派任务、一键审批工具调用，远程指挥每台机器干活。
自动搜集AI行业资讯，定时生成结构化的日报、周报和月报，帮你轻松掌握前沿动态。

description.en: Wallpaper backgrounds for the DSH web GUI. Windows: reads your Wallpaper Engine (Steam) library and plays video/web wallpapers behind the chat. macOS: scans the WaifuX download folder and loose media folders automatically — anything saved in WaifuX becomes a DSH background with zero setup. Liquid-glass blur, dim and border sliders.
description.zh: DSH Web 聊天背景壁纸。Windows：直接读取你的 Wallpaper Engine（Steam）库，把视频/网页壁纸渲染到聊天界面背后。macOS：自动扫描 WaifuX 下载目录和媒体文件夹——在 WaifuX 里保存的壁纸零配置即可成为 DSH 背景，支持视频与图片。带毛玻璃模糊、压暗、边框调节滑块。

description.en: Settings-driven MCP server manager, inventory Remote, and Web settings UI for DeepSeek Harness

LLM-as-a-Verifier for dsh with the Best-of-N conversation mode built in: rank N candidates with a fine-grained verifier (expected grade over the logprob distribution), on demand via the verify tool or automatically on every turn of a Best-of-N session. In
Host-only peer session relay tools for DeepSeek Harness
A Luo Xiaohei-inspired animated dark theme for DeepSeek Harness
Durable provider-neutral Wait, Event, and Delivery runtime for DeepSeek Harness.
DSH Settings plugin manager bundle for Desktop and native Web profiles
OpenAI-compatible web search provider (Responses API + web_search tool) for DeepSeek Harness — works with Qwen Token Plan, OpenAI and other compatible gateways, with an in-GUI configuration card

The rich `edit` tool for DeepSeek Harness (replace / patch / apply_patch / hashline modes) with embedded format-on-write and diagnostics — a standalone plugin with no upstream harness changes required.
Post-edit diagnostics for DeepSeek Harness: runs configured type-checkers and linters after a successful write/edit and feeds the findings back to the model as tool-result context
Market-data seam for DeepSeek Harness: one typed interface for candles and symbols, any provider behind it (bring your own data)
DeepSeek Harness 插件合集（整合包）：按人群一键装齐整套插件。Curated persona plugin bundles for DeepSeek Harness.
DSH（DeepSeek Harness）插件：会话标题栏一键导出当前会话 —— 「保存 MD」下载纯净 Markdown，「保存 HTML」下载带左侧目录、表格与代码块渲染的网页。自动过滤模型思考过程与工具调用记录，只保留用户与助手的正文，适合归档、分享与撰写报告。
description.zh: 在会话头部一键将当前对话导出为带目录的 Markdown 或 HTML 文件，方便保存和分享。

description.en: Windows-native capability pack for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): clipboard, notifications, hosts file, network diagnostics and more — safe PowerShell-backed tools for Windows users.
Shows the account balance or coding-plan quota (5h/7d/30d) of the provider behind the current model, in one line under the composer; display only, no cost accounting.
description.zh: 在输入框统计行下方一行显示当前模型所属供应商的账户余额或套餐额度（5h/7d/30d）；只做显示，不做成本统计。

description.en: Sign in to AI coding plans that have no API key — Claude Pro/Max/Team, ChatGPT Plus/Pro, Copilot, SuperGrok — from the dsh settings UI.
description.zh: 没有 API Key 也能登录 Claude、ChatGPT、Copilot 等 AI 编程套餐，直接在 dsh 设置里完成授权。

description.en: Per-workspace custom system prompts for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): one active prompt per workspace, captured into a session at creation time, editable from a session-header dialog.
description.zh: 为每个工作区设置独立的系统提示词，创建会话时自动生效，并可在会话中随时修改，让AI更贴合你的项目需求。
